name: ABC Legal
desc:
Document Retrieval Specialist (Remote) | $15.00/hr | Data Entry Heavy, Some Outbound Follow-Up Calls, No Sales Expectations
Company: ABC Legal Services
Industry: Law and Legal Services

What Your Day Will Look Like:
ABC Legal is the national leader in delivering legal papers, and this role makes sure the right court documents come back on time. You'll review and pull legal documents using ABC Legal's own online tools and email. When a court is late sending a document electronically, you'll call or email court clerks and judicial assistants to follow up. If something doesn't match, you'll dig in and figure out why. You'll work closely with the e-Filing team, take part in ongoing training, and help with extra projects. It's steady, detail-heavy computer work with a little phone and email follow-up.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail
- Accuracy on repetitive tasks
- Polite, professional follow-up
- Problem solving
- Teamwork
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment after applying or after initial contact with recruiter
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED required
Required Experience: No experience necessary
Preferred Experience: Data entry experience is a plus

Required Skills:
- Typing speed of 50 to 60 WPM
- Exceptional attention to detail
- Ability to do repetitive tasks accurately
- Basic Microsoft Office skills
- Desire and ability to be a team player
- Must live in Indiana, Iowa, Wisconsin, North Dakota, Kentucky, Alabama, Florida, Oklahoma, Michigan, North Carolina, or South Carolina

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Types fast and accurately and likes steady, focused work
- Is new to remote work, since no experience is needed
- Is comfortable making short professional calls and emails to courts
- Wants to learn the legal industry from the inside

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Types under 50 words a minute
- Gets bored with repetitive tasks
- Doesn't want to make any phone calls
- Wants a job with lots of variety hour to hour
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Document retrieval
- Data entry accuracy
- Legal documents
- Court follow-up
- Typing speed and accuracy
- Investigating discrepancies
- Phone and email communication
- Microsoft Office
- Attention to detail
- Team collaboration

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- How fast do you type, and how do you check your work for mistakes?
- How would you follow up with a court clerk about a document that's overdue?
- What would you do if a document didn't match what you expected?
- Tell us about a time you had to stay accurate on repetitive work. What was the task, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
- Tell us about a time you had to follow up with someone to get something you needed. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $15.00/hr, confirmed in posting.
-Shift: Full-time, Monday through Friday. Hours aren't listed, so ask in the interview.
-Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, paid time off, 7 paid company holidays, 4 floating holidays per year, life and AD&D insurance, long term disability, health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts, an Employee Assistance Program, and pet insurance.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case.
-Drug Test: Certain positions.
-Notes: No experience is needed, so this is a good first step into remote work and the legal industry. Oklahoma is one of the eligible states. A typing speed of 50 to 60 WPM is expected. The posting title says Document Retrieval Specialist, but the overview calls it an E-Fulfillment Specialist, so you may see both names. Benefits are strong for an entry level job, including a 401(k) match, 11 paid and floating holidays, and pet insurance. ABC Legal has been in business for over 30 years and has an office in Oklahoma City. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Document Retrieval Specialist → Senior E-Fulfillment Specialist → e-Filing Team Lead → Operations Supervisor. This role builds data entry, legal document, and court communication skills.
